subject.title: Package publish stuck pending after staged upload timeout

question: Should maintainers recover this exact pending `@alan512/experienceengine@0.5.3` attempt after artifact verification, or clear it so the same immutable version can be resubmitted?
rationale: The repository state and scanner outcome must be inspected with privileged operational access, and the durable retry/cancel contract affects publishing policy rather than being safely inferred from the report alone.

options.title: Verify and recover the pending attempt
options.body: Inspect the stored artifact and scan records, then resume or rerun checks only if they match the reported validated 0.5.3 payload.

options.title: Clear the reservation for resubmission
options.body: If the stored attempt cannot be safely attributed or resumed, remove the nonterminal reservation so the owner can submit the same version again through normal checks.

recommendation.title: Verify and recover the pending attempt
recommendation.body: Inspect the stored artifact and scan records, then resume or rerun checks only if they match the reported validated 0.5.3 payload.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion and subscription timeline make this the best available operational routing signal.
